note: Things a temple should have and keep in order. Visitors rate each item 1-5 stars, comment and upvote. Item keys are stable and must never be renamed.

items.label: Dustbins present and used
items.hint: Are bins placed around the temple and are they actually used?

items.label: Clean floors and premises
items.hint: Corridors, prakaram and entrance free of litter and spills.

items.label: Flower and puja-waste disposal
items.hint: Garlands, leaves, coconut shells and oil collected and removed.

items.label: Temple tank or water body
items.hint: Water clean, no floating waste or algae. Skip if the temple has none.

items.label: Drainage and wash areas
items.hint: No standing water, bad smell or blocked drains.

items.label: Footwear stand
items.hint: A safe, organised place to leave footwear.

items.label: Shade and queue shelter
items.hint: Cover from sun and rain while waiting.

items.label: Ramp and accessibility
items.hint: Step-free path for wheelchairs, elders and prams.

items.label: Lighting
items.hint: Enough light in the complex and approach road at night.

items.label: Signage and rules
items.hint: Clear boards for timings, rules and directions.

items.label: First aid
items.hint: A first-aid point or trained help.

items.label: Security and crowd management
items.hint: Orderly queues and a safe crowd at busy times.
